title: Concept: PHP fatal error with its file and line
description: A PHP fatal error that names the file and the line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message names the absolute file and the line, which combined with the framework version points at the exact code path that failed and how it can be reached again.
applicability: Deployments that render a PHP fatal error that names the file and the line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message names the absolute file and the line, which combined with the framework version points at the exact code path that failed and how it can be reached again.
